results.title: Trump’s job approval rating is low by historical standards

results.content:
It is a safe and potentially profitable expectation to say that Trump’s approval rating will be below 37% before year’s end. But given Trump’s known ability to get off the canvas, survive an onslaught, and win, it’s risky to bet against him rebounding — at least slightly — and managing to keep his approval rating from sinking any lower.
